name: Python AST architecture controls
implemented_controls: Required package/domain/application roots and nonempty Python scans
AST static import boundaries, including nested relative and package imports
Configured internal-layer and persistence/transport package exclusions
Known literal dynamic loaders and rejection of unresolved known loader targets

No database, auth, payment, tenancy, deployed entry-point or operational product validation was performed.
